posts.name: iFixAi
posts.tagline: Independent auditing of AI agents to uncover misalignment
posts.description: iFixAi is an independent auditor helping companies assess whether they can trust their AI agents. Unlike relying solely on evals and observability tools, its multifaceted audit includes 250 inspections across 69 categories of AI misalignment, combining AI red teaming, operational assurance, and philosophical, ethical, and sociological perspectives. It identifies failures under testing, explains their business implications, and provides evidence engineers can use to investigate and fix them.

posts.name: LUCI Desktop
posts.tagline: Let your AI agents remember what you've seen
posts.description: Luci saves your screen history and meeting transcripts locally, so agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can help you find a page you forgot to bookmark or recall a decision from a call. Capture context across apps without setting up a connector for each one. Includes on-device transcription and daily summaries with Microsoft Foundry Local. Free for Mac and Windows.

posts.name: ZenABM
posts.tagline: Create, optimize & report on LinkedIn Ads from any AI tool
posts.description: Ditch copy-pasting into Campaign Manager! Create, launch & optimize your LinkedIn Ad Campaigns from your favourite AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) with ZenABM’s MCP server or natively with our AI Agent Zena - both equipped with 20+ expert skills and 96 tools! +Automate your reporting (including company engagements & revenue attribution) with weekly & monthly reports produced by our AI Agents Zena.

posts.name: Semos.ai Manager Agents
posts.tagline: AI agents purpose-built for managers
posts.description: Manager Agents learn from your meetings, then point you to what needs your attention next: the feedback that is overdue, the recognition you missed, the conflict you are avoiding, the growth talk that keeps slipping. You learn what works, what doesn't, and why, so you become better at leading your people.

posts.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
posts.tagline: Anthropic's second model in the Claude 5.5 family
posts.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is Anthropic’s fast, cost-efficient AI model for everyday work: coding, bug fixes, documents, slides, and design. It runs 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5, lowers task costs up to 30%, and delivers stronger coding and knowledge-work performance.

posts.name: Paste 7
posts.tagline: Intelligent clipboard that knows what you're about to paste
posts.description: Intelligent Clipboard is new in Paste, the productivity app that remembers everything you copy. Paste now suggests which of your copied items you'll most likely paste next, based on what you're working on. Powered by Apple Intelligence, privately on your Mac.

posts.name: Hopscotch AI
posts.tagline: 500+ AI models available via a single API
posts.description: 🎁 PRODUCT HUNT EXCLUSIVE: The first 250 PH users to sign up get $50 in free model credits. Create your free account and redeem code HOPSCOTCH50OFF in the Billing tab. | 🚀 Access 500+ AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more through one API. Use multiple providers without managing separate integrations, accounts, or payments. Compare models on your prompts, configure fallbacks, and track usage and spend in one place. Pay provider rates with no platform fees or token markup.

posts.name: Timeless Code
posts.tagline: Meeting notetaker that installs and runs inside Claude Code
posts.description: An AI notetaker that lives inside Claude Code. Claude sets it up for you, and from then on you can record meetings and ask about anything that was said, right from your terminal.

posts.name: Would you pay?
posts.tagline: Find out who'd pay before you build more
posts.description: Most side projects fail quietly: months of building, then nobody pays. Would you pay? shows your startup to real people who swipe right only if they'd pay for it. You see the % who'd pay, who they are, and who clicked through. Free.

posts.name: Pokébinder
posts.tagline: Plan your Pokémon binder, then print what's missing
posts.description: A free binder planner for Pokémon TCG collectors. Search 40,000+ English and Japanese cards, arrange 3×3 pages, run your own art behind a whole page with cards on top, then print true-size placeholders for the cards you don't own yet. No account — your binder stays in your browser.

posts.name: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude
posts.tagline: Create, send, and sign documents in ChatGPT and Claude
posts.description: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude brings document creation and e-signatures directly into your AI workspace. Create signature-ready documents from a prompt or uploaded file, edit content and signing fields, manage recipients and signing order, send documents for signature, and track their progress without switching tools. Existing Jotform Sign users can also access and manage their workflows right from ChatGPT or Claude.

posts.name: Engine Room Media
posts.tagline: We Run The Numbers. You Run The Show.
posts.description: Built for Creator growth, Engine Room brings all of your platform analytics, media kit, and rate cards together in one easy to use dashboard. Engine Room Media helps creators grow across all their favorite platforms (including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Patreon, Spotify, and Twitch) with data-driven insights, brand deals, and peer connections.

posts.name: Curie
posts.tagline: Assistant for scientific literature and document analysis.
posts.description: Curie is an AI research assistant built for real scientific work, not a generalist chatbot. It searches PubMed, arXiv, Europe PMC, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar in parallel, then verifies every claim against the source text, so you see what's backed and what isn't. Point it at a document to extract structured data with the quote behind each value, or run a full systematic review, protocol, screening, PRISMA diagram, with you approving every decision. Projects and a library keep it organized.

posts.name: Arsaze
posts.tagline: Let Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini edit your real timeline
posts.description: Arsaze is the AI video editor for agents and humans — think Cursor for video editing. A real multi-track timeline that both you and an AI agent can drive over MCP or by talking to it, for AI video editing, AI video generation, and agent-driven video editing on one real timeline.

posts.name: Imejis.io
posts.tagline: Give your agent a design studio to automate your marketing
posts.description: Your AI agent writes the copy. With Imejis, it ships the image too. Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI agents a design studio via MCP. Create, edit, preview, and render production-ready graphics. Build OG images, social cards, marketing graphics, charts, certificates, QR codes and more. Design once. Generate at scale. Unlike generative image models, Imejis is deterministic: the same input produces the same pixels, keeping your brand, layout, typography, and data consistent. Free to start

posts.name: Gladys Assistant 5
posts.tagline: Private, self-hosted smart home, no YAML required
posts.description: Gladys Assistant is a free, open-source smart home platform that runs on your own mini-PC or Raspberry Pi. Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter and 90+ community integrations, a phone-first dashboard, no YAML, and it keeps working when the internet goes down.

posts.name: Declutr
posts.tagline: Tidy your Mac's desktop and downloads in one click
posts.description: Declutr sorts your Desktop, Downloads or any folder into folders by file type in one click: Images, Documents, Videos, Archives, Code, 3D Models and more. One Undo puts every file back. New since the first launch: it's on the Mac App Store, with Smart Rules (name, extension, age, size), watched folders that sort new files as they land, and a daily cleanup. Rules, not AI: it never reads what's inside your files. Free to sort, Pro is $8.99 once.

posts.name: Supertake
posts.tagline: AI that turn your ideas into real investments
posts.description: Supertake transforms your unique takes on the world into real, shareable investment portfolios using frontier AI and trading agents. Until now, we’ve invested at the mercy of financial managers, ETFs, and single stocks promoted by grifters and algorithms. But with Supertake you simply tell the agent what you believe in natural language and it creates a magical portfolio of assets and places the trades on your behalf. Supertake works with existing brokerages like Robinhood and Coinbase.

posts.name: Clink
posts.tagline: The iOS keyboard you actually own
posts.description: Clink is a custom iOS keyboard and a place for indie apps and brands to live on it. Themes, layouts and tools you control, plus partners who put their brand in the thing you type with all day. Privacy focused and headed to Android soon!

posts.name: ShipHappens:
posts.tagline: ASO, keywords & screenshots for the app store
posts.description: App Store Connect is slow, clunky, and buries everything that actually gets you downloads. ShipHappens is the native Mac app I built to fix that. Pick keywords using Apple's own search popularity data, make screenshots with AI, translate your listing into 39 languages in one go, A/B test your product page, and reply to reviews in any language. A feed across all your apps tells you what to fix next. Your key stays in your Keychain, and you can bring any AI provider or run a local model.

posts.name: GhostDeck
posts.tagline: Offline Mac music player with living low-poly worlds
posts.description: GhostDeck plays your own music files in the classic late-'90s deck layout, with a ten-band EQ and a playlist that snap together. Behind your album, a jewel case turns over one of five low-poly worlds that move to the music. Native Metal, offline, no tracking.

posts.name: ColdIQ x Slack
posts.tagline: Prompt GTM systems inside Slack
posts.description: Prompt GTM systems inside Slack. Tag ColdIQ Bot and watch it build GTM systems for you. Your teammates can edit, reply and iterate directly in the thread. Discover what Slack looks like once you access: 40+ Data Providers without paying for each one. 100+ GTM skills that will help you book meetings. A database built on 5+ years of experience running GTM for 300+ teams. The easiest to go from text prompts to campaigns that generate revenue. Try it here: https://coldiq.com/slack

posts.name: FFFFinder
posts.tagline: Browse images and videos across folders in one grid
posts.description: FFFFinder is a fast media browser for macOS. Add any folder and browse images and videos from that folder and all of its subfolders together in one continuous grid. Filter, sort and search files, preview images and videos, and browse connected external drives. FFFFinder works directly with your original files. There’s no importing, no separate media library, no account and no cloud.

posts.name: Timeful
posts.tagline: Design web apps and sync with your own codebase
posts.description: Timeful is a local-first visual editor that syncs with your codebase. Build your website or app on a visual canvas and Timeful instantly outputs clean, production-ready code for Vue, Nuxt, and Tailwind. All using predictable algorithms, without spending a single AI credit. Prefer coding? Edit the code and the canvas updates immediately via true two-way sync. You fully own the code: build in your own repository, review and merge changes, and deploy anywhere with zero vendor lock-in.

posts.name: Szept
posts.tagline: Say it. Show it. Hand it to your agent.
posts.description: Szept is a light, fast Mac app for talking to AI agents: dictate in 60+ languages, clean up text with AI, capture and record the screen, and hand it to Claude Code. Source code included.

posts.name: ooon.ai
posts.tagline: AI employee that answers, books, and reminds clients
posts.description: Most booking tools wait for the client to open an app or fill a form. ooon.ai answers inside the chat the client already has open, in WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram, so no message goes unanswered. It explains prices and services, finds an open slot, books the client, sends a reminder before the visit, and reaches out to clients who stopped replying, around the clock, in Russian, Kazakh, or English. The owner gets one dashboard with every conversation, booking, and revenue total

posts.name: GroupShelf
posts.tagline: Tabs for every window on your Mac
posts.description: GroupShelf groups windows from any Mac app into tabs, like browser tabs for your whole desktop. Hold Shift and drag one window onto another to make or join a group. Move or resize one window and the whole group follows. Pull a tab off to split it again, color your tabs, name your groups. Native and lightweight, for macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon and Intel. $9.99 one-time, with a 30-day free trial of every feature.

posts.name: Enter Space 7
posts.tagline: rclone for iPhone, iPad, Mac & TV — now with Finder mounts
posts.description: Enter Space puts rclone's 70+ storage providers (S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, SFTP/NAS, WebDAV and more) inside the Files app, Finder and a full native app. Version 7 adds FSKit volume mounts on macOS 27, a Photos timeline and a film Theater that run on storage you own, and point-in-time backups with Time Portal. It also brings duplicate finding, Space Inspector and a code editor with git. Secrets stay in your Keychain and nothing is collected.

posts.name: Ricly
posts.tagline: Putting your most recurring tools in the right-click menu
posts.description: Every small file task on a Mac ends in a browser tab: upload, wait, download, close. Ricly puts 17 of those tools in the Finder right-click menu: send big files as a link, find duplicates, merge PDFs, strip the location data out of a photo, pull the text out of an image, remove a background, upscale, convert, compress. They run on your Mac, and nothing is uploaded unless you deliberately share a file. One price instead of five single-purpose subscriptions.

posts.name: Tipword
posts.tagline: Hold a key to translate any word on your Mac
posts.description: Hold a key over any word on your Mac and see its translation instantly. Works in subtitles, websites, PDFs, photos and chats, in 50+ languages. Pay $12 once, with no subscription.

posts.name: Flotnote
posts.tagline: Floating Markdown notes for Mac. Pay once, own your files
posts.description: Flotnote is a Markdown notepad that floats above every app on your Mac. Hit one shortcut, write the thought down, and get back to work. Every note is a plain Markdown file in a folder you choose, so Obsidian and any other editor can open it right away. Full-text search, wiki-style links, tags, and several floating notes at once. No account, no servers, no subscription.

posts.name: Codex Remote
posts.tagline: Put Codex or Claude Code on your own cloud machine
posts.description: Codex Remote is an open-source Mac menu bar app for putting Codex and Claude Code on a cloud machine you control. Choose a provider and size; it provisions the server with OpenTofu, installs the agents, and connects the machine to the apps you already use. See CPU, memory, and active sessions, pause idle servers, sync a project, or let an agent manage machines with opt-in MCP access. Your cloud credentials stay on your Mac. No hosted middleman. Independent of OpenAI and Anthropic.

posts.name: Iris
posts.tagline: AI agents built for your company’s operations
posts.description: Iris integrates AI agents into the workflows and tools your company already uses. Agents coordinate work across teams, follow up through Slack and iMessage, update systems, and move recurring processes forward. Build agents for operations, GTM, sales, customer success, finance, recruiting, and more, with shared company context, custom workflows, and approval controls.

posts.name: SuperData
posts.tagline: Know the person behind every work email.
posts.description: Start with a work email or public profile URL and get structured person and company data through an API. SuperData helps developers enrich leads, complete CRM records, and give AI agents useful context without stitching together multiple data sources. Explore the docs, test the API, and build with usage-based credits.

posts.name: PrivacyPolicy Generator by CookieYes
posts.tagline: GDPR & CCPA privacy policies that auto-update
posts.description: Generate a privacy policy that stays current as the rules change, so the version on your site does not quietly go out of date. Every website needs one, and almost nobody wants to write it. Answer a few plain questions about how your site handles data, and get a policy tailored to your practices and aligned to GDPR (EU and UK), CCPA/CPRA, and more. Free to generate, multilingual, from the team behind CookieYes CMP.

posts.name: Hunch
posts.tagline: AI formulas that score, tag and classify any text column
posts.description: Every row gets a number you can sort. =HUNCH(A2, "Is this lead a decision maker?") returns a probability. HUNCHPICK picks one option from your list, HUNCHSCORE places the text on your scale, HUNCHMULTI answers several yes/no questions per row at once. Drag it down, then sort, filter and color as usual. Works in Google Sheets and Excel with one key. 100 rows free, then $29 for 5,000. No subscription, credits never expire. Powered by Jev, TypeSafe's judgment model.

posts.name: Rowform
posts.tagline: The most affordable Typeform alternative
posts.description: Rowform is an AI-powered form builder that turns a simple prompt into a polished, conversational form in seconds. Customize every question with drag-and-drop editing, smart logic, branded themes, and translation into 15+ languages. No code required. Publish with a shareable link, embed anywhere, collect responses, and track results with built-in analytics. Import existing Google Forms or Typeforms, then connect submissions to Google Sheets, Zapier, and the tools your team already uses.

posts.name: Recallfox
posts.tagline: Remember everything you learn
posts.description: Recallfox combines interactive Lessons and Learning Paths with spaced repetition flashcards that come back before you forget, helping knowledge stick.

posts.name: Kivo
posts.tagline: Find inspiration. Remix it into an editable design
posts.description: Kivo is an AI-native design workspace where users can discover ideas in a personalized, Pinterest-like feed, generate a slide or poster inspired by one, and immediately edit the result. Midjourney and Nano Banana generate images. Kivo generates the editable design itself - real text, fonts, and separate layers, generated together in a single step.

posts.name: Brouky
posts.tagline: Brouky.tech - The mirror of VC world.
posts.description: What is brouky.tech? We are monitoring venture capital market and make it easy for you. If you are a startup looking for invetment, pick your round and in about 30 seconds you get the VCs and angels most likely to back your company. We have making descitions based on 122,000+ real investments,37,000+ investors, 134,000+ startups, 140+ countries. Try it free: your 5 best-matched investors, no login. For average round you will need a list of 100.

posts.name: Buba
posts.tagline: Personalized wellbeing practices, matched to how you feel
posts.description: Buba is a science-backed wellbeing app. Practice breath, voice, movement and journaling, and see what actually shifts your state. Download on iOS.

posts.name: Werds
posts.tagline: A word building game
posts.description: Werds is a word puzzle game for iPhone and iPad. Find words from letters on the grid. Rearrange your found words to use as much space as possible and rearrange the letters to make better scoring words. Try to use all of the tiles to maximize your score. At the end, form the words you found into a bit of silly poetry and share with friends to compete for the best score.

posts.name: skya.one
posts.tagline: See what ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity say about your brand
posts.description: SKYA tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, and Google AI Overviews describe your brand, then helps you catch what they get wrong and publish the fixes. Get a visibility score per platform, benchmark against named competitors, and see exactly which prompts surface you (or don't). 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

posts.name: EventHunt AI
posts.tagline: Know which events are worth your time before you go
posts.description: You have a few evenings a week and hundreds of events to pick from. EventHunt scores every one against what you want out of a room: deals, hires, builders, investors. You write filters in plain English. The best few hit your inbox, or your agent via API. Free. Built with Jev.

posts.name: EventPixel
posts.tagline: Collect every guest photo with one QR code. No app needed.
posts.description: Guests scan a QR code and every photo lands in one live gallery. No app, no account. Hosts get a photo wall for any TV, PixelFind AI face search that gives each guest their own photos, guestbook, RSVP and full-res download. Free to start, paid events one-time.

posts.name: AccessFlow — Software access requests
posts.tagline: Control access. Cut waste. Stay secure.
posts.description: AccessFlow is the internal portal where employees request software licenses and IT admins approve them, with a full audit trail per company. One platform. Smarter access. Less wasted spend. • Automate employee access and offboarding • Reclaim unused SaaS licenses • Track software spending in real time • Streamline software approval workflows • Monitor license utilization • Improve security with centralized access control • Turn overlooked SaaS waste into measurable savings

posts.name: UPSKaiLL
posts.tagline: Skills matching, custom learning and curated jobs in one.
posts.description: UPSKaiLL (upskaill.ai) is an all-in-one platform to learn fast and grow your career. A coaching interview maps your skills across 55,000+ roles, including 300+ emerging roles, builds a custom 1-of-1 learning journey, then curates live job postings with direct-apply links. Try the demo without signing up: pick any emerging role on the homepage and the coach walks you through that path. Voice or text. Free 7-day trial, no card needed.

posts.name: JointSesh
posts.tagline: Track your cannabis sessions, effects, habits & spending
posts.description: JointSesh is a free, privacy-first cannabis tracker and journal for more mindful consumption. Log each session, track strains and effects, monitor frequency and spending, and spot patterns in your habits over time. No account, no cloud sync, and no subscriptions for core features. Your cannabis journal stays private and on your device.

posts.name: Heimlog
posts.tagline: 400 clips in. One ready-to-share video out.
posts.description: Love filming, hate editing? Heimlog turns your raw travel footage into a first-cut vlog. AI sorts your clips, builds the structure, generates captions, and blurs bystanders. You review and export in about 10 minutes.

posts.name: convly
posts.tagline: Your WhatsApp & Teams messages in Slack
posts.description: We built convly to bridge Slack and Teams. Now it's grown up: WhatsApp lands right inside Slack too. Same DNA: 2-minute setup, nothing changes for your contacts, and you keep your existing number. WhatsApp DMs, group chats, files, images, voice messages and member lists, all from Slack. Free for 1 seat. Stop juggling between Slack, Teams and WhatsApp.

posts.name: CastCut
posts.tagline: Your podcast, already cut when you open Final Cut Pro
posts.description: CastCut is a Mac app that edits multicam video podcasts for you. Drop in your camera files and audio: it syncs everything by sound, cuts to whoever is talking (even from one shared mic), clears dead air and filler words, and finds the clips worth posting as shorts. Then it opens a normal, editable multicam timeline in Final Cut Pro, with Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve in beta. Runs fully offline on Apple silicon. First 2 exports free, no account.

posts.name: Reloop Domain Age & Warmup Checker
posts.tagline: Check if your domain is too new to send emails
posts.description: Domain age is one of the biggest reasons cold emails land in spam and most senders have no idea. This free tool lets you check any domain: Exact age (years + days), Registration & expiry date, Warmup stage: Too New / Cold / Warming / Established, Deliverability risk - will your domain hurt your emails? Just paste any domain or URL. Results in 2 seconds. No sign-up. Perfect for founders doing cold outreach, email marketers, and developers. Built by Reloop - open-source email infrastructure.

posts.name: Kinu
posts.tagline: Private personal CRM for people who notice the little things
posts.description: Kinu is where you keep what you notice about people: birthdays, gift ideas, the new job a colleague mentioned over coffee. When it's been a while, a gentle reminder brings someone back to mind. No pipelines, no feed, no streaks. What you save is encrypted before it leaves your device. Free is the complete app with room for 10 people, no card and no time limit, on iPhone, Android or in a browser. Kinu Plus adds unlimited people and encrypted sync.

posts.name: Tvara: AI Gym, Running & Food
posts.tagline: Gym, runs, food, sleep. One app, one honest readiness score
posts.description: Four apps — gym, food, running, sleep — and none of them talk to each other. Tvara is all four, and they finally do: last night's sleep changes today's workout, today's run lands in tomorrow's readiness, your cycle shows up in the plan. One honest score each morning — a range when the signal is thin — and it works with no wearable. Food by photo or voice, 1,800+ exercise clips, GPS runs, sleep, habits, fasting. GLP-1 mode free. No ads. iOS, Android, Watch, Wear OS. 5 languages.

posts.name: CareerZenith
posts.tagline: Everything you need before you apply.
posts.description: CareerZenith helps you go from resume to application-ready in one place. Check your resume readiness, improve content with AI, optimize your resume for specific job descriptions, identify relevant keywords, and strengthen your LinkedIn and GitHub profiles. Built to reduce guesswork and help you create stronger, more targeted applications—faster.

posts.name: Sidian DataGuard
posts.tagline: Nothing sensitive leaves your firm. Even into AI.
posts.description: Checks everything leaving your firm, redacts what shouldn't go, and gives you a governed private AI you own instead of a black box you rent.

posts.name: F-Droid 2.0
posts.tagline: The FOSS Android store, rebuilt after a decade
posts.description: F-Droid 2.0 is the biggest rebuild of the official Android client in a decade. It brings a modern interface, much better discovery and search, smoother installs, and automatic updates while keeping the store free of tracking and engagement tricks.

posts.name: Unleaf
posts.tagline: Research Papers Made Easy
posts.description: A fast, minimal LaTeX editor that works instantly in your browser. No account, no project setup, no clutter. Open it, write, compile, leave. Unleaf is a lightweight LaTeX editor for people who just want to write. I got tired of opening a full platform every time I wanted to quickly edit or compile some LaTeX, so I built something simpler. Just open Unleaf, start typing, and compile. It's especially useful for quick assignments, equations, papers, snippets, etc

posts.name: Atako
posts.tagline: A new workspace for human-agent collaboration.
posts.description: Atako is the collaboration layer for the hybrid workforce. Deploy AI agents in their own VMs, let them work with each other and with your team, and see everything that happens. One place to steer the work your agents deliver alongside your team. 🖥️ Agents with their own VM and role 🤝 Agent-to-agent collaboration 🙋 Human notices for decisions and validations 📋 Shared projects and company context 👀 Full observability on agent work 🔑 Atako credits or your own API key ☁️ Cloud or on-premise

posts.name: Amplifly
posts.tagline: The app that learns the brain you actually have
posts.description: A flow and strengths tool for neurodivergent minds. Check your brain state, get matched techniques, log your sessions, and build a personal operating manual — computed on your device. Out now on iOS as Amplifly Lite; BioProxal wearable integration in development.

posts.name: SDE Forge
posts.tagline: AI-powered software engineering interview prep platform
posts.description: Prepare for software engineering interviews with SDE Forge. Practice LLD and HLD with AI mock interviews, build custom and company-wise DSA sheets, learn through interactive lessons, and track your progress — all in one place.

posts.name: Zeku
posts.tagline: A calm place to write for your Astro site
posts.description: Zeku is a native app that opens your Astro project directly, with live-preview markdown, frontmatter that knows your schema, and a publish button.

posts.name: Endorse
posts.tagline: Find UK research jobs linked to Global Talent Visa funders
posts.description: Most UK research job adverts don't say which grant funds the role. So Global Talent Visa (Route 3) candidates spend hours checking PIs, projects and grant databases by hand. Endorse reads university careers pages and matches research and technical roles to official funding records, across all 24 Russell Group universities. It's a first-pass discovery tool, not immigration advice.

posts.name: Zoffer Bills
posts.tagline: Forward a bill on WhatsApp. Find it in Zoho Books.
posts.description: Your vendors already send bills on WhatsApp. Now forward them to Zoffer. It reads each bill, printed or handwritten, pulls out the vendor, date, line items, tax and amount, and creates the entry in your Zoho Books. Nothing posts until you check it and tap approve. No new app to learn. You keep using Zoho Books the way you do today, minus the typing. Made for small businesses in India that get dozens of bills a month and don't want to hire someone just to enter them. ₹999/month.

posts.name: 2FA Authenticator
posts.tagline: Modern authentication in Chrome. 200,000+ users trust us.
posts.description: Most authenticators want an account, a cloud, or permission to read every page you visit - and they live on your phone. This one lives in your browser and has no server at all. Codes are one click away, no reaching for your phone. Password-protect the vault, unlock it with Touch ID, and share a code by link that carries pre-computed codes - never your secret key.

posts.name: BankStore
posts.tagline: The AI bridge between banks and businesses globally
posts.description: Banks say no and never say why. BankStore changes the rules: you choose the bank, the bank doesn't choose you. We score 1,400+ providers in 60+ countries on jurisdiction, business model, volume and ownership, then show you why. One KYB profile for accounts, cross-border payments, FX and acquiring: one screen instead of five inboxes. Compare terms, fees, products and coverage, and see why each one fits your business. Haven't opened your account yet? Check your bank matches for free.

posts.name: Riplox Desktop
posts.tagline: Share a link from your phone. Your PC downloads it.
posts.description: Riplox is a free, open-source video downloader for Windows. Paste a link and keep the file at up to 8K, or MP3. Or pair your phone once and share links from any app: your PC downloads them, even if it was off when you sent them. Only the link travels, sealed, and on the same Wi-Fi it never leaves your network. Whole playlists and channels, Following for new uploads, convert, trim, schedule, and a public Board of links. No account, no caps, no ads, nothing bundled. GPL-3.0.

posts.name: Lume
posts.tagline: Notes that arrive before the thought leaves
posts.description: Lume is a native Windows notes app (WinUI 3, no Electron) that stays hidden until you need it. Shake your mouse or press a shortcut, write, and it's gone. Beyond quick notes: a scratchpad that does maths as you type and runs small Python, JS or PowerShell snippets, pen ink right on top of your text, and freehand boards next to your notes. Local-first, optional OneDrive sync. Free for up to 20 notes.

posts.name: Orate
posts.tagline: The teleprompter that doesn't lose your take
posts.description: Most teleprompter apps fill the screen with your script, so your eyes visibly travel to read it. Orate keeps the script in a narrow band right under the front camera, so you stay looking at the lens. Takes are crash-safe: if the app is killed mid-recording, you keep everything up to that second. Read times are measured per language, not from an English word count. No account, no watermark, nothing uploaded, and it works offline. 12 languages, iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Orthodate
posts.tagline: Faith-first dating for Orthodox Christian singles
posts.description: Orthodate is a free dating platform built specifically for Orthodox Christian singles seeking meaningful relationships and marriage. Discover faith-centered profiles, connect through intentional likes and matches, and meet Orthodox Christians beyond your local parish. With nearly 3,000 members worldwide, Orthodate helps a geographically dispersed community find genuine, lasting connections.

posts.name: Mind Atlas
posts.tagline: Map how your mind works: imagery, memory, inner voice
posts.description: Some people see vivid pictures when they close their eyes, others see nothing. Mind Atlas turns five short self-tests (visual imagery, the other senses, autobiographical memory, inner voice and a perception experiment) into a living map of your mind. After three you meet your archetype, after five your atlas is complete, with a Full Mind Report that is free during our pilot. No sign-up, and your answers never leave your browser. In 5 languages.

posts.name: Evolution of the Web
posts.tagline: Experience 35 years of the web in one website
posts.description: Remember when websites had visitor counters, guestbooks, blinking GIFs and “Best viewed in Internet Explorer”? Evolution of the Web lets you travel through the internet one era at a time, from the early ’90s all the way to a speculative 2040. Every era changes the design, technology, interactions and culture of the site itself. How many eras of the web do you remember?

posts.name: Workmode
posts.tagline: Find the best places to work remotely from
posts.description: Coffee shops, coworking spaces and quiet corners — rated on wifi, noise and comfort by the people who work from them.

posts.name: Open World Clock
posts.tagline: Time zones for Windows, free and open source
posts.description: A world clock for Windows made for working with people in other time zones. Add the cities you work with and see them side by side. Type a time or scroll over any clock and every city converts at once. The meeting planner shows the hours when everyone is inside working hours, and there's a live day and night map. Free and open source (MIT), no ads, no account, and the app sends nothing anywhere. On the Microsoft Store, or try the real app in your browser first.

posts.name: heade.rs
posts.tagline: See where any website lives and how your traffic gets there
posts.description: Every domain lookup site looks like it's from 2004. So I built the one I wanted: https://heade.rs Type in any website and see where it's hosted, the route your traffic takes to get there, what it's built with, who registered it, and which AI bots it lets in. Fast, beautiful, free, no sign-up, and works from a terminal or MCP.

posts.name: Goldseat
posts.tagline: Give your product the spotlight it deserves.
posts.description: GoldSeat is a simple directory for discovering and promoting great products. List your product, SaaS, or app for free. If you want more visibility, you can pay to move into a higher spot. No subscriptions. No complicated packages. Just a simple way to put your product in the spotlight. Built for makers who want more people to discover what they’ve built.

posts.name: Siena - Networking Done For You
posts.tagline: Ask for connections, Siena will get straight to finding them
posts.description: Your Waivly Concierge 🌎 Looking for someone, something, or somewhere to start? Tell me what you need and I’ll see what I can find.

posts.name: Tidyshot
posts.tagline: Blur, annotate and find any screenshot by its text
posts.description: Tidyshot lives in your Mac menu bar and handles every screenshot you take. Blur or pixelate private info and add arrows or callouts in one click. It reads the text on-device, so you can find any screenshot by what's written on it. Receipts, code and links land in Smart Collections, and everything is sorted by app. Redact covers emails, phones, cards and QR codes before you share. Works with ⌘⇧4, CleanShot or Shottr. No account, no cloud, no subscription.

posts.name: Dealenz
posts.tagline: AI contract review, drafting, and signing made simple.
posts.description: Upload any contract, instantly uncover hidden risks clause-by-clause, draft bulletproof documents, and sign securely—all in one place. Stay fully covered without the hefty legal fees..

posts.name: WordCanvas3D
posts.tagline: See how AI reads text: tokens, embeddings and vector math
posts.description: WordCanvas3D is a free, open-source playground for how AI understands text. Split any sentence into tokens and compare how GPT and LLaMA tokenizers see it. Fly through thousands of words in 3D and watch similar meanings cluster together. Do math with meaning, like king − man + woman ≈ queen. New in v2: a Learn section with beginner-friendly articles and interactive figures, a full redesign, phone support, and English, Chinese, Japanese and Spanish.

posts.name: Bloque
posts.tagline: The hosted MCP gateway for teams without an IT department
posts.description: Point Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex — any MCP client — at one endpoint. Configure MCP servers for your whole team, store credentials once (encrypted), give every member their own key, and see who called what. No Kubernetes, no sales call. From $29/mo.

posts.name: ChatGPT Update Notifier
posts.tagline: Get notified on updates for the ChatGPT Linux app.
posts.description: Well, I kept missing ChatGPT desktop app updates and was suprised that the Linux app did not have an update flow built-in. I am sure OpenAI will eventually address this. Until then, here is a small, unofficial notifier for the ChatGPT desktop app on Linux. The Windows version of the app already has this update-checker feature. It checks the signed OpenAI package repository and reminds you about newer app versions. It never installs an update without your confirmation.

posts.name: Port42 · What will you imagine?
posts.tagline: A Mac desktop where your AI companions build together
posts.description: Port42 is a Mac desktop for your AI companions. Claude Code and Codex build live apps together on one desktop, in the same chat as you. Port42 runs no model and holds no key.

posts.name: VidScope
posts.tagline: Extract every tool mentioned in a YouTube tech video in 30s
posts.description: VidScope turns technical YouTube videos into structured, verified knowledge: every tool, framework, and technology mentioned, with official links, extracted by AI with zero extrapolation.

posts.name: CraftCX
posts.tagline: Observability & Intelligence tooling for AI Support Agents
posts.description: Understand every conversation your AI support agent handled, identify recurring customer issues, and review the evidence behind every finding with CraftCX.

posts.name: Briskly
posts.tagline: Couch to 5k but for cleaning
posts.description: The cleaning app for people who hate cleaning. Point your camera at the mess and Briskly's AI scans the room, builds a timed task list, and races you through it. About 20 minutes, then swipe the before/after slider for proof you actually did it. On-device Vision AI (no cloud, no data collected), lock screen Live Activity, Apple Watch support, and Spotify/Apple Music built in. Unlike schedule-based cleaning apps, Briskly assumes you'll never follow a schedule. Done before you know it.

posts.name: ModusPad
posts.tagline: Launchpad is back, and now it switches with your work
posts.description: macOS Tahoe replaced Launchpad with the Apps view. ModusPad brings the full-screen app grid back with pages, folders, search, drag & drop, and one-click import of your old Launchpad layout. But it goes beyond recreating Launchpad: profiles like Work, Home, or Studio each have their own layout, hidden apps, and apps to launch, and switch automatically with Focus modes, connected displays, or schedules. Built for macOS 26 & 27. No account required. Free for 14 days, then a one-time purchase.

posts.name: Asortino
posts.tagline: The screener for tokenized stocks and ETFs
posts.description: Browse and analyze thousands of tokenized stocks and ETFs. Compare issuers, chains, and assets, and find what you're looking for. Unbiased data and analytics tools. Browse every asset, chain, and issuer on the market, compare them side by side and screen assets according to your criteria.

posts.name: Nivoli Edge
posts.tagline: Shields and locks for WordPress, enforced at the edge
posts.description: Nivoli Edge puts a powerful security layer in front of WordPress. Attacks, traffic floods, scanners, and unauthorized code changes are blocked at Cloudflare’s edge before they ever reach PHP. Its security controls are protected by email confirmation and managed outside WordPress, so even a compromised site cannot disable them or install malicious software. The same global edge network delivers complete HTML pages and perfectly sized images from the location closest to each visitor.

posts.name: SkillKeeper
posts.tagline: Track your whole AI setup, from the menu bar
posts.description: SkillKeeper shows which skills, agents, tools, MCP servers, commands, memory, hooks and plugins actually ran on your Mac, how many tokens each one spent, and what needs attention: loops, clashing triggers, skills that never fire. See how each skill is wired, catch what drifts from what you meant, and fine-tune it without opening a single file. Product Hunt visitors get 20% off with the code launch

posts.name: Usage Buddy
posts.tagline: See all your coding-agent usage and reset times in one place
posts.description: UsageBuddy gives developers one place to track their Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor usage. Add multiple accounts, see remaining limits and reset times, and get alerts before you run out. Everything is visible in a simple desktop app, so you don’t have to open multiple tools or remember which account has usage left.

posts.name: Fud AI
posts.tagline: Free open-source AI calorie & workout tracker
posts.description: Fud AI is a free, open-source calorie and workout tracker for iOS and Android. Snap up to 10 meal photos, scan a barcode, speak, or type — AI estimates nutrition. Bring your own key (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, and more); optional hosted AI on iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Also: workout diary with an 877-exercise library, intermittent fasting, water, widgets, Apple Watch, HealthKit / Health Connect, and an AI Coach — all local-first and MIT licensed.

posts.name: Curio
posts.tagline: Learn one big idea a day, and actually remember it
posts.description: Most of what you learn is gone within a week. Curio gives you one real idea a day, like why the Moon changes shape or why sequels disappoint, taught in a few minutes with visual cards and questions that make you think. Then it brings each idea back right before you'd forget it, with a new question each time, until it's locked in. 254 hand-written ideas across 16 topics, in paths that unlock chapter by chapter. Free on iPhone, no ads, no account.

posts.name: Noera
posts.tagline: One mindful sentence a day, one ritual at a time
posts.description: Noera gives you one curated sentence a day, a guided breathing practice, and 21-day focus cycles you actually finish. Pick what matters (calm, confidence, focus, healing) and the app adapts. Each morning you choose one of three cards to reveal the day's message, then record it in your own voice and play it back. One gentle reminder at the time you pick, no spam, no streak shaming. Home screen widgets, 7 languages. Free on iOS and Android; Premium unlocks every focus cycle.

posts.name: Reamer Research
posts.tagline: Deterministic research engine for mid-frequency quants
posts.description: A research engine for mid-frequency strategies on OHLCV bars. Test, diagnose and sweep in Python or C++, then carry the logic live with Reamer Server. A fixed seed gives byte-identical results, slippage included. Linux and macOS. $1,800/yr; 30-day trial $225.

posts.name: Nottez.app
posts.tagline: Canvas, workflow and CRM in one app, on web and phone
posts.description: Three workspaces that share one account: an infinite canvas for thinking, a workflow board for doing, and a CRM for the people paying you. Works on the web and on your phone, in 11 languages. Free plan, no card. 7 days free on Pro.

posts.name: FireWatch AI
posts.tagline: Open-source wildfire history and spread exploration
posts.description: Explore historical wildfire progression, inspect environmental data, and experiment with spread scenarios in an open-source research prototype. Built with React, Leaflet, TypeScript and Python. MIT-licensed code, documented data gaps and scoped contributor tasks. Research use only; not validated for emergency decisions.

posts.name: Copper
posts.tagline: Cook the world with what you already have
posts.description: Copper turns "what should I cook tonight" into two clicks. Tick the ingredients in your kitchen and it shows traditional dishes from around the world you can actually make with them. 588 dishes from 196 countries — ingredients, steps and cooking time, free to read on the web. The iOS app adds a fridge scanner, shopping lists and offline access.

posts.name: kdpbook.io
posts.tagline: Lovable for books: chat your idea, get a KDP-ready book
posts.description: kdpbook.io is an AI book studio for Amazon KDP. Think Lovable, but for books: describe the book you want in a chat, or import your manuscript, and it writes, illustrates and typesets it. Then it exports the files KDP asks for: interior PDF, full-wrap cover PDF sized from the page count, Kindle EPUB and a listing sheet. 36 book types, from picture and coloring books to novels. KDP trim, bleed, margin and spine rules are applied by code. 2,000 free credits at signup, no card.

posts.name: PriceTag: Currency translator
posts.tagline: Select any price on the web to see it in your currency
posts.description: A Chrome extension that converts any price you select into your currency, right below it in a speech bubble. 161 currencies. Free.
